text: Sensei Deck only. Energy attack. For the remainder of Combat, when your opponent tries to discard or remove from the game one of your cards in play, you may remove from the game 2 cards in your Sensei Deck to keep it in play. Remove from the game after use.

name: Orange Style Mastery (BuS)
text: Once per Combat during your "Attacker Attacks" phase, you may discard one of your Orange Style Drills in play to search your Life Deck for 2 different Drills and place them into play. During your REjuvenation Step, you may place the top Drill in your discard pile on the bottom of your Life Deck.

name: Red Cross Punch
text: Sensei Deck only. Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. For the remainder of Combat when you perform a focused attack, you may remove from the game 2 cards in your Sensei Deck to have that attack do an additional +3 power stages of damage.

name: Red Style Mastery (BuS)
text: When you perform a Red Style attack, you may discard the top card of your Life Deck to make it a focused attack. After you stop an attack with a Red Style card that does not remove itself from the game, place it on the bottom of your Life Deck.

name: Saiyan Pressure Technique
text: Sensei Deck only. Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. For the remainder of Combat, when you perform a Saiyan Style physical attack, you may remove 2 cards in your Sensei Deck from the game to double the Base Damage of the attack. Remove from the game after use.

name: Saiyan Style Mastery (BuS)
text: You cannot win by the Most Powerful Personality Victory. All of your Saiyan Style attacks gain "Raise your anger 1 level. Gain 3 power stages." During the Rejuvenation Step, if you put any Saiyan Style cards back into your Life Deck, raise your anger 2 levels and your Main Personality gains 4 power stages.

name: Supreme Kai's Help
text: Use when entering Combat. You may search your Life Deck for any level of Supreme Kai and place it into play at his highest power stage. For the remainder of the turn, Supreme Kai may use his Personality Power without taking control. If your Supreme Kai is in play at the end of Combat, you may shuffle him back into your Life Deck.

name: Supreme Kai's Ki Push
text: Focused energy attack. If you declared a Tokui-Waza and your Main Personality is above level 1, you may have him lose a personality level to have this attack do an additional +7 life cards of damage. Remove from the game after use.

name: The Fusion Dance
text: If you have Goten and Kid Trunks in play at the same personality level, you may fuse them with the Gotenks Fusion card of the same personality level.

name: The Eternal Dragon's Quest
text: Search your Life Deck and any cards in play for all Dragon Balls you own and set them aside into a new stack. At the beginning of each of your turns, choose a Dragon Ball that is not in play from that stack and place it into play. Card powers cannot end Combat for the remainder of the game.

name: Majin Buu (level 5)
text: Focused physical attack doing 10 power stages of damage, or shuffle 10 cards from your discard pile into your Life Deck instead.

name: Goku, Super Saiyan 3 (level 5)
text: At the beginning of every turn choose 2 of your Goku's lower personality levels. For the remainder of that turn, Goku has the Powers and Constant Combat Powers of those 2 chosen levels.

name: Master Roshi Sensei
text: (Deck Size: 9) All of your attacks do +1 life cards of damage. All of your opponent's attacks do -1 life cards of damage.

name: Gotenks (level 1)
text: Physical attack doing 7 power stages of damage. This power may be used twice per Combat. When you perform this attack, you may discard a card from your hand to make this a focused attack.

name: Gotenks, Super Saiyan (level 2)
text: Energy attack doing 8 life cards of damage. Costs 0 power stages to perform. This power may be used twice per Combat. When you perform this attack, you may discard a card from your hand to make this a focused attack.

name: Goku (level 1-BuS)
text: (Constant Combat Power) When entering Combat, you may remove 7 Saiyan Style cards in your discard pile from the game to advance a personality level. All of your physical attacks do +1 life cards of damage.

name: Goku, Super Saiyan (level 2)
text: (Constant Combat Power) When entering Combat, if you have not used a Constant Combat Power this turn, you may remove 7 Saiyan Style cards in your discard pile from the game to advance a personality level. Prevent 2 life cards of damage from any attacks performed against you.

name: Goku, Super Saiyan 2 (level 3)
text: Physical attack doing +5 power stages of damage. If the top card of your discard pile is a Goku Named card, this is a focused attack and lowers your opponent's anger 3 levels.

name: Goku (level 1-BuS HT)
text: (Constant Combat Power) Your physical attacks do an additional +2 power stages of damage. Your physical attacks from Goku Named cards do an additional +3 power stages of damage instead.

name: Goku (level 2-BuS HT)
text: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. If you have performed at least 2 Saiyan Style attacks this Combat, this attack does an additional +3 power stages of damage and raises your anger 1 level.

name: Gohan (level 1-BuS)
text: (Constant Combat Power) During Combat, cards cannot make you discard cards from your hand. If a card requires you to discard a card from your hand to use it, you do not have to discard a card to use the effect.

name: Gohan (level 2-BuS)
text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. You may discard any amount of your Non-Combat cards in play. For each Non-Combat card discarded this way, this attack does an additional +4 life cards of damage.

name: Gohan, Mystic Training (level 3)
text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. Cost 1 power stage to perform. This attack cannot be stopped. Efects that prevent damage prevent twice their amount for this attack. Lower your opponent's anger 3 levels.

name: Gohan (level 1-BuS HT)
text: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. If successful, you may search your Life Deck for either a Drill that raises your PUR or a Drill that lets you gain power stages, and place it into play.

name: Gohan (level 2-BuS HT)
text: (Constant Combat Power) You may skip your Power Up Step. If you do, draw 2 cards at the beginning of your next step.

name: Kid Trunks (level 1-BuS)
text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. If successful, for the remainder of Combat you may discard the top card of your Life Deck instead of paying costs for any energy attacks Kid Trunks performs.

name: Kid Trunks (level 2-BuS)
text: (Constant Combat Power) During your "Attacker Attacks" phase, you may discard a card from your hand to have Kid Trunks perform an energy attack that costs 2 power stages to perform.

name: Kid Trunks (level 3-BuS)
text: Energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage. Cost 3 power stages to perform. For the remainder of Combat, your Kid Trunks does not have to pay power stages to perform energy attacks.

name: Kid Trunks (level 1-BuS HT)
text: Focused energy attack doing 3 life cards of damage. If successful, all of your energy attacks do +2 life cards of damage for the remainder of Combat.

name: Kid Trunks (Level 2-HT)
text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. If successful, you may remove from the game a Non-Combat card or Ally in play. Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels.

name: Goten (level 1-BuS)
text: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. You may remove 3 cards in your discard pile from the game to have this attack do an additional +3 life cards of damage.

name: Goten (level 2-BuS)
text: Physical attack doing +3 life cards of damage. You may remove any number of cards in your discard pile from the game to have Goten gain the same number of power stages. Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels.

name: Goten (level 3-BuS)
text: Physical attack doing 5 life cards of damage. You may remove 4 cards in your discard pile from the game to make this a focused attack, raise your anger 1 level, and lower your opponent's anger 2 levels.

name: Goten (level 1-BuS HT)
text: Physical attack doing 3 power stages of damage. If successful, all of your physical attacks do +3 power stages of damage for the remainder of Combat.

name: Goten (level 2-BuS HT)
text: (Constant Combat Power) When Goten performs a Styled physical attack, you may remove 4 cards in your discard pile from the game to make it a focused attack.

name: Piccolo (level 1-BuS)
text: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. Place the bottom card of your discard pile at the bottom of your Life Deck. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level.

name: Piccolo (level 2-BuS)
text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. For the remainder of Combat, if you just used a card to place or shuffle cards from your discard pile into your Life Deck, you may also place the bottom 2 cards of your discard pile on the bottom of your Life Deck.

name: Piccolo (level 3-BuS)
text: Energy attack doing 7 life cards of damage. For the remainder of Combat, you do not have to remove a card from the game to use its Endurance.

name: Piccolo (level 2-BuS HT)
text: Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. Choose 3 cards with different titles in your discard pile. Your opponent chooses one of the 3 cards. The chosen card is placed into your hand and the other 2 cards are removed from the game.

name: Majin Dabura (level 1-BuS)
text: (Constant Combat Power) When a focused attack you perform is successful, you may use its "If successful" effects twice.

name: Majin Dabura (level 2)
text: (Constant Combat Power) All focused attacks you perform do +2 life cards of damage and gain "If successful, discard one of your opponent's Allies in play."

name: Majin Dabura (level 3)
text: Focused physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. For the remainder of Combat, all attacks you perform with Styled and Named cards are focused attacks.

name: Majin Dabura (Level 2)
text: Focused physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. You may remove from the game any cards in your discard pile with the word "focused" in the power box. For every card removed this way, this attack does an additional +3 power stages of damage.

name: Majin Babidi (level 1-BuS)
text: (Constant Combat Power) When defending against an attack, you may have one of your Allies take control of Combat till the beginning of your next "Attacker Attacks" phase, even if Majin Babidi is 2 power stages above 0.

name: Majin Babidi (level 2)
text: (Majin Babidi does not have to be in control of Combat to use this Constant Combat Power) Constant Combat Power: When your opponent would discard any of your Allies in play, you may choose for any of those Allies not to be discarded. Discard the top 5 cards of your Life Deck for each chosen Ally.

name: Majin Babidi (level 3)
text: Energy attack doing +1 life cards for each Ally you have in play. All of your Allies gain 1 power stage. Lower your opponent's anger 3 levels.

name: Majin Babidi (level 1-HT)
text: (Constant Combat Power) When entering Combat, you may discard the top 2 cards of your Life Deck. If you do, for the remainder of that Combat you may discard a card from you hand during your "Attacker Attacks" phase to have one of your Allies take over Combat until the beginning of your next "Attacker Attacks" phase.

name: Majin Babidi (level 2-HT)
text: (Majin Babidi does not have to be in control of Combat to use this Constant Combat Power) Constant Combat Power: All attacks your Allies perform do an additional +3 life cards of damage.

name: Majin Vegeta (level 1 - BuS)
text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. If successful, search your discard pile for a card with "Majin" in the title and place it on top of your Life Deck.

name: Majin Vegeta (level 2)
text: (Constant Combat Power) Any attacks you perform that have "Majin" in the title are focused attacks. During the Rejuvenation Step, if you place a card with "Majin" in the title at the bottom of your Life Deck gain 5 power stages.

name: Majin Vegeta (level 3)
text: Focused energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage. You may discard a card with "Majin" in the title from your hand. If you do, this power may be used a second time this Combat.

name: Majin Vegeta (level 1-HT)
text: Stops a physical attack. Search the top 3 cards of your Life Deck for a card with "Majin" in the title and place it into your hand. The other cards are placed on top of your Life Deck in any order.

name: Majin Vegeta (level 2-BuS HT)
text: (Constant Combat Power) When you and your opponent use the Physical Attack Table for a physical attack, the Base Damage of the physical attack is reduced by -2 when performed against Majin Vegeta and gains +2 when performed by your Majin Vegeta.

name: Majin Buu (level 1)
text: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. If you did not declare a Tokui-Waza, you may use this power a second time this Combat.

name: Majin Buu, the Rotund (level 2)
text: Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. For the remainder of Combat, all of your other physical attacks do +2 power stages of damage.

name: Majin Buu, Pink People Eater (level 3)
text: (Constant Combat Power) You cannot use Endurance. The first life card of damage from the first 2 successful attacks performed against you are placed in your hand instead of discarded or removed from the game. All of your physical attacks do +3 power stages of damage.

name: Majin Buu (level 1-HT1)
text: (Power 1): Shuffle the top 2 Styled cards of your discard pile into your Life Deck. (Power 2: Constant Combat Power) Prevent 2 life cards of damage from each attack your opponent performs.

name: Majin Buu (level 2-HT1)
text: (Power 1:) Stops a physical or energy attack. This card can stop focused attacks. (Power 2: Constant Combat Power) After taking damage from an attack, take the top card of your discard pile and place it at the bottom of your Life Deck.

name: Majin Buu (level 1-HT2)
text: (Power 1:) Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. Raise your anger 1 level. (Power 2: Constant Combat Power) All of your attacks do an additional +1 life cards of damage.

name: Majin Buu (level 2-HT2)
text: (Power 1:) Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. (Power 2:) Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage.

name: Red Pulverize
text: Physical attack. Empower 4. Search your Life Deck for up to 5 Red Style Drills and place them into play. Raise your anger 1 level. Remove from the game after use.

name: Surrounded!
text: For the remainder of Combat, when one of your Allies uses a personality power to perform an attack it does an additional +2 life cards of damage. Remove from the game after use.

name: Orange 5-Finger Focus
text: Focused energy attack doing 2 life cards of damage. Costs 1 power stage to perform. Remove from the game after use. Empower 4. This attack is no longer focused. This attack stays on the table to be used 2 more times this Combat without using its Empower.

name: Watching From Afar
text: Use only at the beginning of your Discard Step in a turn that you skipped Combat. Shuffle 4 cards in your discard pile into your Life Deck.

name: Vegeta's Pride Drill
text: All attacks you perform with Named cards that match your Main Personality do +2 power stages of damage. If your Main Personality is Vegeta, his PUR is increased by +1.

name: Gohan, Mystic (level 4)
text: (Constant Combat Power) Gohan's PUR gains +X. X = the number of Gohan Named cards in your discard pile. All attacks Gohan performs do +3 power stages of damage.

name: Broly (level 1)
text: (Constant Combat Power) When you perform an attack, raise your anger 1 level. If Goku is in play, raise your anger 2 levels instead.

name: Broly, the Enraged Saiyan (level 2)
text: (Constant Combat Power) When entering Combat and the top card of your discard pile is a Saiyan Style card, you may remove it from the game to raise your anger 2 levels, and for the remainder of Combat, all physical attacks you perform do +2 power stages of damage.

name: Broly, Super Saiyan (level 3)
text: Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. If the top card of your discard pile is a Saiyan Style card the first time you perform this attack each Combat, then this attack may be used a second time this Combat, and all attacks you perform do +2 life cards of damage for the remainder of Combat.

name: Broly, the Legendary Saiyan (level 4)
text: This power may only be used once per game. Shuffle the top 15 Saiyan Style cards in your discard pile back into your Life Deck.

name: Broly, the Unstoppable (level 5)
text: (Constant Combat Power) When entering Combat, you may discard a card in your hand. If you do, for the remainder of Combat any Saiyan Style attacks Broly performs are focused attacks.

name: Broly's Energy Burst
text: Energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage. Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels.

name: Broly's Evil Drill
text: Villains only. When entering Combat as the active player, you may search your Life Deck for a "Villains only" card and place it into your hand. If Broly is your Main Personality, you may also use this Drill when entering Combat as the opposing player. You can only have 1 "Broly's Evil Drill" in play at a time.

name: Broly's Might
text: Energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage. If used by Broly, your opponent cannot use Combat cards for the remainder of Combat. Remove from the game after use.

name: Broly's Overwhelming Attacks
text: Broly only. Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. If the top 2 cards of your discard pile are Saiyan Style cards, this is a focused attack and for the remainder of Combat, damage from your attacks cannot be prevented.

name: Broly's Supreme Power
text: Broly only. Stops a physical or energy attack. This card stays on the table to be used 1 more time this Combat. If used a second time this Combat, remove it from the game. At the end of Combat, if this card is used only once this Combat, shuffle it back into your Life Deck. Limit 2 per deck.

name: Saiyan Broly Smash
text: Endurance X. X = 6 if Broly is your Main Personality, otherwise X = 3. Physical attack doing +2 life cards of damage. If used by Broly, this attack does an additional +3 power stages of damage and discards one of your opponent's Non-Combat cards in play.

name: Saiyan Charge
text: Physical attack doing 7 power stages of damage. If the personality performing this attack has a higher power rating than the personality defending against this attack, your opponent cannot use Mastery and Sensei cards for the remainder of the turn.

name: Saiyan Cliff Slam
text: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. If the personality performing this attack has a higher power rating than the personality defending against this attack, discard one of your opponent's Non-Combat cards in play.

name: Saiyan Clothesline
text: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. If the personality performing this attack has a higher power rating than the personality defending against this attack, double the Base Damage from the Physical Attack Table for this attack.

name: Saiyan Enraged
text: Raise your anger 2 levels. Place the bottom 2 cards in your discard pile at the bottom of your Life Deck. If your Main Personality's power rating is higher than your opponent's Main Personality's, draw a card. Remove from the game after use.

name: Saiyan Setup
text: Energy attack. If the personality performing this attack has a higher power rating than the personality defending against this attack, the next Styled attack you perform this Combat become a focused attack.

name: Saiyan Surprise
text: Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. If the personality performing this attack has a higher power rating than the personality defending against this attack, discard up to 2 of your opponent's Allies in play.

name: Battle of the Saiyans
text: Saiyan Heritage only. Use when performing an attack. That attack does an additional +2 life cards of damage for each Saiyan Heritage personality card you have in play. Draw a card. Remove from the game after use.

name: C Techniques
text: Physical attack. Choose a rarity. For the remainder of Combat, all cards in your discard pile are now of the chosen rarity while in your discard pile.

name: Goku's Instant Teleportation
text: Goku only. Search your Life Deck for a Battleground or Location and place it into play. For the remainder of the turn, no other Battlegrounds or Locations can be placed into play and the New Battleground or Location cannot be discarded or removed from the game.

name: Goku's Running Defense
text: Heroes only. Stops a non-focused energy attack. Stops all non-focused energy attacks performed against you for the remainder of Combat. Limit 1 per deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Heroic Drill
text: Heroes only. When entering Combat as the active player, you may search your Life Deck for a "Heroes only" card and place it into your hand. You can only have 1 "Heroic Drill" in play at a time.

name: Power Smack
text: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. This attack does an additional +X life cards of damage, where X is the personality's PUR. Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels.

name: Pure Defense
text: Use in your opponent's "Attacker Attacks" phase when he performs an attack. All secondary effects of that attack are now "If successful" effects. Draw a card. You may still defense against the attack.

name: Krillin's Quick Kicks
text: Krillin only. Physical attack doing +1 power stage of damage. Raise your anger 1 level. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level. This card stays on the table to be used 2 more times this Combat. Remove from the game after use.

name: Efficient Medicine
text: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. You may discard one of your Non-Combat cards in play. If successful and you discarded a Non-Combat card for this effect, your opponent cannot use Non-Combat cards for the remainder of Combat.

name: Master Roshi (Level 1)
text: Physical attack doing 3 life cards of damage. For the remainder of Combat, all attacks your Allies perform do an additional +1 power stages and +1 life cards of damage.

name: Comet Kumolre
text: Place this card into play and place the bottom 3 cards of your Life Deck under it. At the beginning of each turn, remove from the game one of those cards. When you remove the last card, discard any Battlegrounds or Locations in play and none may be played for the remainder of the game.

name: Mind Control Device
text: Attach this card to a Main Personality. While attached, when a card effect would raise his anger, that amount is reduced by 1 before modifiers unless he has used "Goku's Farewell." Only 1 "Mind Control Device" may be attached to this personality at a time.

name: New Vegeta
text: When entering Combat, discard one of your Non-Combat cards in play.

name: Paragus (level 1)
text: (Paragus does not have to be in control of Combat to use this Constant Combat Power) Constant Combat Power: If your Main Personality is Broly, no card effects can lower Broly's anger and personality levels, and card effects cannot prevent Broly from gaining anger except for "Mind Control Device".

name: Heroic Double Team
text: Heroes only. Choose one of your Allies in play. If you chose an Ally draw a card. For the remainder of Combat, the chosen Ally may take control of Combat even if your Main Personality is 2 power stages above 0 or higher.

name: Namekian Precise Aim Drill
text: You may discard a card in your hand that can perform an energy attack to stop an energy attack. Raise your Main Personality's PUR by +2 while this Drill is in play.

name: Power Transfer
text: For the remainder of Combat, at the beginning of each of your "Attacker Attacks" phases, you may have one of your Allies in play pay any amount of power stages to have your Main Personality gain an equal amount of power stages.

name: Saiyan Energy Toss
text: Energy attack. If the personality performing this attack has a higher power rating than the personality defending against this attack, raise your anger 1 level and for the remainder of Combat all of your other attacks do +2 life cards of damage.

name: Vegeta's Energy Blast (BM)
text: Energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage. If used by Vegeta, then for the remainder of Combat the bottom 15 cards in your discard pile are Vegeta Named cards while in your discard pile.

name: Outburst Drill
text: Your Non-Drill cards that have headshots that match your Main Personality are considered Named cards for your Main Personality.

name: Goku's Power Strike
text: Endurance 3. Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. If your Main Personality is at level 2 or above, this attack does an addition +4 life cards of damage and is a focused attack. If successful, search your Life Deck for a Drill and place it into play.

name: Black Misguiding Punch
text: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. For the remainder of Combat or until you opponent plays "Black Misguiding Punch" [whichever happens first], when your opponent searches a Life Deck or discard pile for a card, you may search and choose the cards instead of your opponent.

name: Goku's Face Break
text: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. If you have 6 or more Drills in play, this is a focused attack and does an additional +7 life cards of damage. If successful, shuffle all Drills in your discard pile back into your Life Deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Releasing Untapped Potential
text: You may put any cards in your discard pile into your Sensei Deck. This power cannot raise your Sensei Deck above its maximum deck size. Your Main Personality gains 5 power stages.

name: Black High Kick
text: Endurance 3. Physical attack. This attack does +2 life cards of damage for each Dragon Ball you control.

name: Black Jaw Hammer
text: (If you discard this card for your Black Style Mastery, place this card at the bottom of your Life Deck instead.) Endurance 2. Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. Raise your anger 1 level. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level.

name: Black Shift Kick
text: Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. Stops an energy attack during your opponent's next "Attacker Attacks" phase. Place the bottom 2 cards of y our discard pile at the bottom of your Life Deck.

name: Blue Knockdown
text: Physical attack doing +5 power stages of damage. Raise your Main Personality to his highest power stage. Place at the bottom of your Life Deck after use.

name: Determination Drill
text: At the end of your turn, if you skipped Combat you may place the bottom card of your discard pile under this Drill. All of your attacks do +1 power stages of damage for each card under this Drill. You can only have 1 "Determination Drill" in play at a time.

name: Dimension Scream
text: Discard a Battleground or Location in play. If used by Majin Buu, raise your anger 1 level.

name: Hercule's Assault Drill
text: All of your attacks do +1 life cards of damage and gain "If successful, the personality that performed this attack gains 1 power stage."

name: Hercule's Immunity
text: Sensei Deck. Hercule only. For the remainder of Combat, Majin Buu cannot performs attacks while your Hercule is in control of Combat as your Ally or Main Personality. Remove from the game after use.

name: Heroic Effort
text: Heroes only. Energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage. If performed against a villain, this attack is focused, gain 2 power stages, and for the remainder of Combat your opponent cannot have Allies take control of Combat.

name: Majin Buu, Evil Buu (level 1)
text: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. Gain 5 power stages. If stopped, draw a card.

name: Majin Buu's Heel Kick
text: Endurance 1. Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. Remove 5 cards in your opponent's discard pile from the game. The personality performing this attack gains 3 power stages.

name: Majin Buu's Taunt
text: You may raise your opponent's anger up by 2 levels if one of your attacks has been successful this Combat. Prevent 3 life cards of damage from the next attack your opponent performs against you this Combat.

name: Nooooooooooooooo!
text: (If you declared a Namekian Tokui-Waza, this is a Namekian Styled Card.) Use when your opponent uses a card effect to discard or remove from the game one of your Battleground or Locations in play. Your Battleground or Locations stays in play. Your opponent discards the top 3 cards of his Life Deck.

name: Orange Splitting Headache
text: Endurance 1. Energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage. You may place 2 cards under all of your Drills that have cards under them.

name: Orange Strength
text: Endurance 2. Physical attack doing +2 power stages of damage. Raise your Main Personality to his highest power stage.

name: Paused Pose
text: Sensei Deck. Use when your opponent fuses. Your opponent fuses at the beginning of his next turn instead.

name: Red Holding Drill
text: All of your attacks do +1 power stages of damage. When an opponent would shuffle one or more cards into his Life Deck, he must place them at the bottom of his Life Deck instead.

name: Red Striking Drill
text: Endurance 2. All of your physical attacks do +2 power stages of damage. Any cards in your Life Deck with Endurance have their Endurance increased by +1.

name: Release
text: Endurance 1. Sensei Deck. Raise your Main Personality to his highest power stage. Discard all cards attached to all personalities in play. Place the bottom card of your discard pile at the bottom of your Life Deck.

name: Saiyan Neutralization
text: Stops an energy attack. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level. Your opponent must skip his next "Attacker Attacks" phase. Shuffle into your Life Deck after use.

name: Saiyan Power
text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. Empower 2. Search your Life Deck for 1 copy of a Saiyan Style Drill that adds damage to your attacks and place it into play. Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels.

name: Saiyan Spindletop Punch
text: Endurance 1. Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. Name a card. If successful and the named card was one of the life cards of damage from this attack, remove your opponent's discard pile from the game and raise your anger 1 level.

name: Taking Cover
text: For the remainder of Combat, when you prevent damage from an attack you may prevent twice as much damage from the attack.

name: Tien's Surprise Technique
text: (If your Main Personality is Tien when you use this card's Endurance, your opponent discards the top 2 cards of his Life Deck and this card is places into your hand instead of being removed from the game.) Endurance 0. Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. Lower your opponent's anger 3 levels.

name: Underdog Drill
text: If your Main Personality's highest power rating is below 500,000 then prevent 2 life cards of damage from all attacks your opponent performs, and all your attacks do +1 power stages of damage.

name: Underdog Drop Kick

text: Endurance 1. Use when you peform an energy attack. This energy attack does +3 life cards of damage. Draw a card.

text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. If used by a Fused Personality, this attack does an additional +X life cards of damage. X = the Base Damage on the Physical Attack Table. Place this card and the bottom 2 cards of your discard pile at the bottom of your Life Deck after use.

name: Vegito's Drop Kick
text: Focused physical attack doing +X power stages of damage. X = the attacking personality's PUR and personality level added together. Raise your anger 1 level. If used by a Fused Personality, place this card and the bottom card of your discard pile at the bottom of your Life Deck after use.

name: Vegito's Leg Catch
text: Stops a physical attack. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level. If used by a Fused Personality, raise your Main Personality to his highest power stage, remove your opponent's discard pile from the game, and place this card at the bottom of your Life Deck after use.

name: Vegito's Uppercut
text: Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level. If used by a Fused Personality, damage from this attack cannot be prevented, gain 3 power stages, and place this card at the bottom of your Life Deck after use.

name: Advanced Basics
text: Main Personalities only. If your Main Personality is at level 2 or higher, you may use one of your Main Personality's lower personality level's powers (excluding Constant Combat Powers and powers that can be used multiple times per Combat). If it is an attack, it does +3 power stages of damage. Remove from the game after use.

name: Apocalyptic Battle
text: You and your opponent discard the top card of your Life Decks. The player who discarded the card with the lowest card number may choose to give up winning by the Most Powerful Personality Victory this game to choose a personality level that both players' MPs can reach. All MPs are advanced or lowered to the chosen level. If there is a tie, nothing happens.

name: Black Big Bang
text: Sensei Deck. Energy attack. Empower 2. If you declared a Tokui-Waza and your opponent declared a Namekian Tokui-Waza, this attack does +10 life cards of damage and is shuffled into your Life Deck after use.

name: Black Dark Energy
text: Endurance 1. Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. Choose any cards in your hand and shuffle them into your Life Deck and draw an amount of cards equal to the amount you put into your Life Deck.

name: Black Jawbreaker
text: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. Attach to your opponent's Main Personality. While attached, all attacks performed by that personality do -2 power stages of damage. Discard this card when the attached personality reaches his highest power stage.

name: Black Karmic Strike
text: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. If your opponent performed a successful physical attack in his previous "Attacker Attacks" phase, any power stages of damage this attack deals are life cards of damage instead. If successful and you declared a Tokui-Waza, look at the top 6 cards of your opponent's Life Deck and place them back in any order.

name: Black Protection Orb
text: Stops an energy attack. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, then for the remainder of Combat during your "Defender Defends" phase, you may remove from the game 2 cards in your Sensei Deck to stop an energy attack. Remove from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Black Restraint
text: Use only if you performed a successful physical attack in your last "Attacker Attacks" phase this Combat. Stops a physical attack. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, then for the remainder of Combat stops all physical attacks performed by your opponent. Remove from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Black Spin Kick
text: Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level. If successful, place 3 cards from your discard pile with the word "Kick" in the title on top of your Life Deck and remove this card from the game.

name: Blue Beatdown
text: Endurance 3. Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. Raise your anger 1 level. If successful, for the remainder of Combat all of your physical attacks have a Base Damage of X when you use the Physical Attack Table. X = 4 minus your opponent's current anger level.

name: Blue Energy Guard
text: Stops an energy attack. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, prevents all life cards of damage from energy attacks your opponent performs for the remainder of Combat. Remove from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Blue Forceful Explosion
text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. Raise your anger 1 level. For the remainder of Combat prevent 1 power stae of damage from your opponent's physical attacks for each Ally you hae in play. Remove from the game after use.

name: Blue Gut Implosion
text: Sensei Deck. Physical attack dong +4 power stages of damage. If you declared a Tokui-Waza and your opponent declared a Saiyan Tokui-Waza, shuffle 7 cards in your discard pile into your Life Deck and lower your opponent's Main Personality 1 personality level. Remove from the game after use.

name: Blue Longshot
text: Endurance 1. Energy attack. Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels. For the remainder of Combat, all of your energy attacks gain "If successful, raise your anger 1 level." Remove from the game after use.

name: Blue Multi-Jab
text: Physical attack doing +1 power stages of damage. This attack stays on the table to be used 1 more time this Combat. Cards that can lower your Main Personality any amount of personality levels cannot be played or used for the remainder of Combat.

name: Blue Stopping Technique
text: Endurance 3. Stops an energy attack. Raise your anger 1 level. Choose 2 Non-Combat cards in your discard pile and place them on top of your Life Deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Blue Weaving
text: Stops a physical attack. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, for the remainder of Combat when taking life cards of damage from a physical attack, all cards in your Life Deck with no Endurance gain Endurance 3. Remove from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Boomstick
text: Physical attack doing 5 life cards of damage. Raise your or your opponent's anger 1 level. If "Locked On" is attached to your opponent's Main Personality, this attack cannot be stopped. Remove from the game after use.

name: Devious Moves
text: Endurance 1. Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. If used by Majin Buu, raise your anger 1 level. This attack cannot be stopped by floating effects and Defense Shields. Place at the bottom of your Life Deck after use.

name: Elder Kai's Sacrifice
text: Discard one of your Allies in play to search your discard pile for another Ally of any level and place it into play at 5 power stages above 0.

name: Gohan's Forearm Block
text: Endurance 1. Stops a physical attack. Raise your anger 1 level. If your personality in control of Combat has a higher power rating than your opponent's Main Personality, this card can stop physical attacks that cannot be stopped.

name: Gohan's Left Energy Release
text: Sensei Deck. Endurance 2. Heroes only. Energy attack. Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels. If successful, your Main Personality gains 5 power stages, and you may reduce the amount of power stages your MP would gain to shuffle a card from your discard pile back into your Life Deck for each power stage reduced. Remove from the game after use.

name: Heroic Charge
text: Sensei Deck. Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. If performed against a Majin, choose a card in your hand that can perform an attack or stop an attack and place it into play. That card is now a Non-Combat card instead of its normal type until it leaves play.

name: Intensity Drill
text: When one of your attacks deal 5 or more life cards of damage, place the bottom card of your discard pile under this Drill. If there are 3 or more cards under this Drill, during your "Attacker Attacks" phase you may discard this Drill. If you do, you cannot win by the Most Powerful Personality Victory, and you may advance or lower your MP to any level.

name: Krillin's Sacrifice
text: Krillin only. Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. For the remainder of Combat, all of your other attacks do +3 life cards of damage, and damage from your opponent's attacks are doubled after modifiers are applied. Remove from the game after use.

name: Majin Buu, Piccolo Absorbed (level 3)
text: (Constant Combat Power) All of your attacks do +3 life cards of damage. When Majin Buu gains power stages from a card effect, he gains double the amount of power stages. When you gain anger, increase that amount by +1.

name: Majin Buu, Super Buu (level 2)
text: (Constant Combat Power) All of your attacks do +X power stages of damage. X = your current anger level. At the end of every turn, place the bottom card of your discard pile at the bottom of your Life Deck.

name: Majin Buu's Bicycle Kick
text: Physical attack doing +5 power stages of damage. If successful, lower your opponent's anger 2 levels, and if he has 0 anger, lower his Main Personality 1 personality level.

name: Majin Buu's Goo
text: Endurance 2. Physical attack doing 3 power stages of damage and +1 life cards of damage for each of your attached cards in play. Lower your opponent's anger 3 levels.

name: Majin Buu's Stomach
text: Sensei Deck. All attacks do +2 power stages of damage. All Fused Personalities in play defuse, and cannot fuse while this Location is in play.

name: Majin Static Orb
text: Majin only. Energy attack. Costs 3 power stages to perform. This attack does an additional +X life cards of damage. X = all of your Allies' PUR's added together. Raise your anger 1 level.

name: Namekian Finger Blast
text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. For the remainder of Combat, all Namekian Style cards in your Life Deck without Endurance gain Endurance 1. For the remainder of Combat, when you use Endurance your Main Personality gains an amount of power stages equal to the damage actually prevented after damage is dealt. Limit 2 per deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Narrow Escape
text: Stops a physical or energy attack. If your Main Personality is at level 2 or above and you have a "Freestyle Mastery" in play, stops all physical attacks and energy attacks your opponent performs for the remainder of Combat. Remove from the game after use. Limit 2 per deck.

name: Orange Energy Break
text: Endurance 1. Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. For the remainder of Combat, you do not have to discard any Drills in play when your Main Personality advances or loses a personality level.

name: Orange Headshot
text: Sensei Deck. Physical attack doing +5 power stages of damage. Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels. If you declared a Tokui-Waza and your opponent declared a Blue Tokui-Waza, discard any 2 of your opponent's Non-Combat, Allies, Location, Battleground, and/or attached cards in play.

name: Orange Laser Drill
text: When you perform an Orange Style attack, you may add an additional +2 power stages to the cost to have the attack do +2 power stages of damage and +1 life cards of damage. You may only use this Drill once per Combat.

name: Orange Protection Drill
text: If you declared a Tokui-Waza, you may remove this Drill from the game when you stop a physical or energy attack to stop all of your opponent's attacks of the same type for the remainder of Combat. Limit 2 per deck.

name: Orange Rush
text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. Costs 1 life card to perform. The next Orange Style attack you perform this Combat does an additional +1 life cards of damage for each Drill you have in play when you perform that attack.

name: Overcharge
text: Endurance 2. Use when you pay for the cost of an energy attack. The personality performing the attack may pay up to 3 addition power stages for the energy attack. For each power stage paid, the energy attack does an additional +2 life cards of damage. Remove from the game after use.

name: Ready for Action
text: Use when your Main Personality advances a personality level or when you fuse. Your opponent skips his next "Attacker Attacks" phase. For the remainder of Combat, all of your attacks do +3 life cards of damage. Place the bottom 3 cards of your discard pile at the bottom at your Life Deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Red Cross Slash
text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. If successful, shuffle 5 Red Style cards in your discard pile into your Life Deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Red Energy Slap
text: Sensei Deck. Stops an energy attack. If you declared a Tokui-Waza and your opponent declared an Orange Tokui-Waza and your opponent has not performed a successful attack this Combat, stops the next 2 non-focused energy attacks your opponent performs this Combat.

name: Red Physical Fortification
text: Stops a physical attack. If you declared a Tokui-Waza and your opponent's current anger level is at 0, stops all physical attacks performed against you for the remainder of Combat. Remove from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Red Rapid Deflection
text: Stops an energy attack. If you declared a Tokui-Waza and your anger level is 1 or higher, stops all energy attacks performed against you for the remainder of Combat. Remove from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Red Rapid Energy
text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels. Empower 3. Place all cards in your discard pile with "Energy" in the title at the bottom of your Life Deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Red Repeating Flares
text: Endurance 2. Energy attack doing 2 life cards of damage. This attack stays on the table to be used 2 more times this Combat. You may discard a card from your hand when you perform this attack to do an additional +3 life cards of damage. Remove from the game after use.

name: Red Static Shot
text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. For the remainder of Combat, your opponent cannot use Endurance against your Red Style attacks. If successful, raise your anger 2 levels.

name: Redeemed
text: (This card does not cause you to have an illegal deck because of hero/villain alignment) If your Main Personality is a villain, he is a hero until the end of the turn. If your Main Personality is a hero, he is a villain until the end of the turn.

name: Saiyan Blitz
text: (When you perform a physical attack you may discard this card from your hand to have that attack do an additional +4 power stages of damage and raise your anger 1 level.) Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. Empower 2. For the remainder of Comat, when you use Empower, you still use all of the effects after the Empower.

name: Saiyan Elusion
text: Stops an energy attack. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, for the remainder of Combat during your "Defender Defends" phase you may discard a card from your hand to stop an energy attack. Remove from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Saiyan Explosion
text: Sensei Deck. Energy attack doing 5 life card of damage. Raise your anger 1 level. Empower 2. If you declared a Tokui-Waza and your opponent declared a Black Tokui-Waza, for the remainder of Combat, your opponent's Combat, Physical Combat, and Energy Combat cards cost +1 power stages to use. Shuffle into your Life Deck after use.

name: Saiyan Gut Kick
text: Endurance 2. Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level. If successful and you declared a Tokui-Waza, search your Life Deck for a Dragon Ball and place it into play. Remove from the game after use.

name: Saiyan Neckbreaker
text: Endurance 1. Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. Raise your anger 1 level. Empower 2. For the remainder of Combat, all of your physical attacks gain "This attack does an additional +X power stages of damage. X = the amount of times you have used Endurance after you played "Saiyan Neckbreaker"."

name: Saiyan Perfect Defense
text: Use only if your Main Personality has a higher power rating than your opponent's Main Personality. Stops a physical attack. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, this card stays on the table to be used multiple times this Combat. Remove from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Saiyan Push
text: Endurance 2. Stops an energy attack. The next energy attack you perform this Combat gains all the secondary effect text of the attack you just stopped. Remove from the game after use.

name: Saiyan Two Gun Woo
text: Energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage. If your Main Personality has a higher power rating than your opponent's Main Personality, this is a focused attack. For the remainder of Combat, when you use Endurance, your Main Personality gains 1 power stage.

name: Sneaky Tricks
text: The cost of this card is discarding a card from your hand. Search the bottom 7 cards of your Life Deck for a Combat, Physical Combat, or Energy Combat card that can perform an attack. Immediately use that card and remove it from the game after use. Remove from the game after use.

name: Unlocked Potential
text: Main Personalities only. If one of your MP's higher personality levels has a Constant Combat Power, you may use that Constant Combat Power for the remainder of the turn. You may only choose 1 Constant Combat Power for each copy of "Unlocked Potential" used.

name: Orange Charge Kick
text: Endurance 1. Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. Empower 2. If successful, take control of one of your opponent's Freestyle Drills in play.

name: Vegeta's Blurred Kick
text: Endurance 2. Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. Gain 3 power stages. Empower 2. If successful, capture an opponent's Dragon Ball. If successful and used by Vegeta, capture 2 of your opponent's Dragon Balls instead. Remove from the game after use.

name: Yamcha, the Amazing (level 1)
text: When entering Combat, you may remove 3 cards in your discard pile from the game to search your discard pile for a card that can perform an energy attack with a Base Damage of less than 6 life cards and place it into your hand.

name: Black Energy Swirl
text: Sensei Deck only. Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, name a word that is not a Martial Arts Style and raise your anger 2 levels. For the remainder of Combat, your opponent cannot play any cards with the named word in the title. Remove from the game after use.

name: Black Uppercut
text: Endurance 2. Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. Raise your anger 1 level. If successful, end any of your opponent's floating effects that do not stop attacks and that last "for the remainder of Combat."

name: Blue Backhand
text: Physical attack doing 5 power stages of damage. For the remainder of Combat, all of your Non-Combat/Non-Drill cards that do not remove themselves from the game after use are placed at the bottom of your Life Deck after use.

name: Blue Leapfrog Drill
text: Sensei Deck only. At the end of every turn, you may place a Non-Combat card in you discard pile at the bottom of your Life Deck. During your "Defender Defends" phase you may discard a card one of your Non-Combat cards in play to stop an energy attack.

name: Blue Lunge
text: Endurance 2. Physical attack doing +5 power stages of damage. Search the top 5 cards of your Life Deck for a Non-Combat card and place it into play. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your Life Deck in any order.

name: Dazed
text: Your opponent must pass his next 2 "Attacker Attacks" phases this Combat. This card has no effect on your opponent if he has the card "Breakfall" in his discard pile and/or his removed from the game pile. Remove from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Den-Goku (level 1)
text: (Constant Combat Power) At the end of your turn, place the bottom 5 cards of your discard pile at the bottom of your Life Deck. All of your attacks gain "Den-Goku gains 3 power stages."

name: Gohan, Earth's Protector (level 5)
text: Energy attack doing 10 life cards of damage. Costs 0 power stages to perform. This cost cannot be modified by any cards.

name: Gohan, Mystic Empowered (level 4)
text: Physical attack doing +5 power stages of damage or energy attack doing 7 life cards of damage. You may discard the top 3 cards of your Life Deck to make this a focused attack and raise your anger 1 level.

name: Gotenks' Kamikaze Ghost
text: (You can have up to 6 copies of this card in your Life Deck.) Gotenks only. Place this card into play. While this card is in play, you may remove it from the game during your "Attacker Attacks" phase to discard the top 6 life cards of your opponent's Life Deck.

name: Hercule-Goku (level 1)
text: (Constant Combat Power) You may use "Villains only" cards. Prevent 2 power stages and 1 life card of damage from all attacks performed against you.

name: Last Ditch Effort
text: Endurance 1. Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. Raise your anger 1 level. If successful, shuffle all cards with Endurance in your discard pile into your Life Deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Majin Buu, Gohan Absorbed (level 5)
text: Physical attack doing +6 power stages of damage. If your opponent is a hero, you may use this power to stop a physical attack instead. Place the bottom 5 cards of your discard pile at the bottom of your Life Deck.

name: Majin Buu, Gotenks Absorbed (level 4)
text: (Constant Combat Power) You may discard down to 2 cards instead of 1 during any Discard Step. When Majin Buu performs an attack, you may pay an additional +2 power stages to make it a focused attack and do +2 life cards of damage.

name: Majin Buu's Energy Spray
text: Majin only. Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. Raise your anger 2 levels. If successful, choose a "Majin only" Energy Combat card in your discard pile and place it into your hand. Remove from the game after use.

name: Majin Buu's Kamikaze Ghost (level 1)
text: (Only Majin Buu may have this personality as an Ally. He may have up to 6 copies of this Ally in his Life Deck and may have multiple copies in play) Remove this personality from the game to discard the top 4 cards of your opponent's Life Deck.

name: Majin Buu's New House
text: All players play with their hands faceup on the table. All Named cards in all players' Life Decks without Endurance gain Endurance 1.

name: Majin Planet Destruction Blast
text: Majin only. Energy attack. This attack does an additional +1 life cards of damage for each "Majin only" card in your discard pile. If successful, shuffle 5 "Majin only" cards in your discard pile into your Life Deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Majin Thrust
text: Majin only. Energy attack doing 7 life cards of damage. All "Main only" cards in your Life Deck without Endurance gain Endurance 1. If your opponent's MP is at a higher personality level than your MP, for the remainder of Combat all of your other attacks do +2 life cards of damage.

name: Namekian Door Explosion
text: Endurance 2. Energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage. If successful, while the current Battleground or Location is in play, your opponent cannot place a new Battleground or Location in play and cannot discard or remove from the game the current Battleground or Location unless he plays "Dimension Scream."

name: Orange Reflex
text: Sensei Deck only. Energy attack. You may pay +4 power stages to search your Life Deck for an Energy Combat card that performs an energy attack and use that card (including its secondary effects) for no cost, instead of this one.

name: Potara Earrings
text: If you have Goku in play choose one of your Vegeta, Hercule, or Dende personality cards in play. If your Goku and the chosen personality are at the same personality level, they may fuse. Attach this card to the fused personality. They only defuse when this card is no longer attached.

name: Red Drop
text: Sensei Deck only. Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. For the remainder of Combat, all of your other attacks do +X power stages of damage. X = your MP's current personality level. Raise your anger level 1. Shuffle into your Life Deck after use.

name: Red Leverage Blast
text: Energy attack doing +X power stages of damage. X = the Base Damage on the Physical Attack Table. Costs 3 power stages to perform. Raise your anger 1 level. If successful, place 3 Energy Combat cards in your discard pile on top of your Life Deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Red Mouth Cannon
text: Energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage or lower your opponent's Main Personality 1 personality level. Remove from the game after use.

name: Red Whiplash
text: Endurance 2. Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. Raise your anger 1 level. Empower 2. If stopped, search the bottom 5 cards of your Life Deck for a Physical Combat card and place it into your hand. The remaining cards are placed on top of your Life Deck in any order.

name: Saiyan Overcharged Blast
text: Sensei Deck only. Energy attack doing +2 power stages of damage. If the personality performing this attack has a higher power rating than your opponent's MP's power rating, this attack costs 0 power stages to perform. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level. This attack stays on the table to be used 1 more time this Combat. Remove from the game after use.

name: Straining Power Move
text: Endurance 2. Energy attack doing +1 life cards of damage for each Straining Move card in your discard pile. Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels.

name: Transformation
text: Use at the end of Combat. You cannot win by the Most Powerful Personality Victory for the remainder of the game. Advance or lower your Main Personality to X. X = your current anger. If X is higher than your MP's highest level, your MP advances to his highest level. If X = 0, then lower your MP to his lowest level.

name: Vegeta's Fury
text: Vegeta and Majin Vegeta only. Attach to your "Majin Vegeta's Rage" that is attached to a "Vegeta's Quickness Drill." While attached, all your Freestyle cards (excluding Non-Combat cards) gain "Remove from the game after use." and when you draw cards with "Majin Vegeta's Rage" and "Vegeta's Quickness Drill"' you may choose the cards in your discard pile instead.

name: Vegito (level 1)
text: (Constant Combat Power) All Goku and Vegeta Named cards that performs attacks do +3 life cards of damage. You do not have to pay costs for any cards unless the card allows you to pay any amount.

name: Gotenks, Super Saiyan 3 (level 3)
text: Physical attack doing +7 power stages of damage. Lower your opponent's anger to 0. Gain 5 power stages. Place the bottom 3 cards of your discard pile at the bottom of your Life Deck. This power may be used a second time this Combat.

name: Vegito, Super Saiyan (level 2)
text: Your opponent discards the top 7 cards of his Life Deck.

name: Goku's Flight
text: Stops a physical or energy attack. Raise your or your opponent's anger 1 level. If you declared a Freestyle Tokui-Waza, stops the next physical or energy attack performed against you this Combat. If used by Goku, place this card at the bottom of your Life Deck after use.

name: Majin Buu's Choke Hold
text: Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. Empower 2. For the remainder of Combat, your opponent's Main Personality loses 1 power stage at the beginning of each of his "Attacker Attacks" phase. If successful, search your Life Deck for a card with "Throw" in the title and place it into your hand.

name: Majin Bibidi, the Mastermind (level 1)
text: For the remainder of Combat, when one of your personalities performs an attack with his personality power, it now does +3 power stages of damage if Majin Bibidi is in play.

name: Peaceful Times
text: Use during your Non-Combat Step if you did not put this card into play this turn. If you and your opponent did not declare Combat on your previous turns, raise your Main Personality to his highest power stage and place 6 cards in your discard pile at the bottom of your Life Deck.

name: The Power of Porunga
text: You may search your Life Deck for a Namek Dragon Ball and place it into play, or you may use this card to win the game when you have 7 Namek Dragon Balls in play and your opponent uses a card to delay your Dragon Ball Victory. Remove from the game after use. Limit 2 per deck.

name: Devastation Drill
text: All of your physical attacks do +5 power stages of damage. Discard this Drill if you have any other Non-Combat cards in play.

name: Supreme West Kai (level 1)
text: (Constant Combat Power) When entering Combat, shuffle up to 5 life cards from your discard pile into your Life Deck.

name: Supreme West Kai (level 2)
text: (Constant Combat Power) When entering Combat, draw the bottom or top card of your discard pile.

name: Supreme West Kai (level 3)
text: (Constant Combat Power) When entering Combat, shuffle up to 5 cards in your discard pile into your Life Deck and draw the top or bottom card of your discard pile.

name: Dr. Willow (level 1)
text: (Constant Combat Power) When entering Combat, remove the top card of your Life Deck from the game to remove the top 2 cards of your opponent's Life Deck from the game and raise your anger 3 levels.

name: Dr. Willow (level 2)
text: Discard 3 cards from your hand to search your opponent's Life Deck for any 5 cards. Your opponent chooses 1 of those cards and puts it into his hand. The others are removed from the game. If Dr. Willow is your Main Personality, advance him 1 personality level at the end of Combat.

name: Dr. Willow (level 3)
text: (Constant Combat Power) When entering Combat, draw 2 cards. When a player performs a successful attack, gain 2 anger. If Dr. Willow is your Main Personality, then when you reach 5 or more anger, he loses 2 personality levels.

name: Zarbon (level 1)
text: (Power 1: Constant Combat Power) All of your attacks gain "If successful, raise your anger 1 level and gain 2 power stages." (Power 2:) Focused energy attack.

name: Zarbon, Transformed (level 2)
text: (Constant Combat Power) When entering Combat, draw the bottom card of your discard pile. All of your attacks gain "If successful, raise your anger 1 level and gain 3 power stages." After damage is dealt to Zarbon, if Zarbon's Power Rating is 0 then lose 1 personality level.

name: Zarbon, Fanatical (level 3)
text: (Constant Combat Power) When entering Combat, draw one of the bottom 3 cards of your discard pile. All of your attacks gain "If successful, gain 4 power stages and remove the bottom 2 cards of your opponent's discard pile from the game." After damage is dealt to Zarbon, if Zarbon's Power Rating is 0 then lose 1 personality level.

name: Turles, the Mysterious (level 1)
text: (Power 1: Constant Combat Power) Damage from your attacks cannot be redirected. (Power 2:) Physical attack doing +1 power stages of damage for each personality in play. Raise your anger 1 level.

name: Turles, the Proud (level 2)
text: (Power 1: Constant Combat Power) Damage from your attacks cannot be prevented. (Power 2:) Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. You may remove an Ally in play from the game. If you do, raise your anger 1 level.

name: Turles, the Saiyan Warrior (level 3)
text: (Power 1: Constant Combat Power) Damage from your attacks cannot be redirected, reduced, or prevented. (Power 2:) Energy attack doing +1 power stages of damage for each Ally in your and your opponent's removed from the game piles. If "Tree of Might" is in play, this attack does +2 power stages of damage for each Ally instead.

name: Caterpy (level 1)
text: (Power 1: Constant Combat Power) All your physical attacks do +1 power stages of damage. (Power 2:) Your opponent discards a card at random from your hand for you to draw a card. Raise your anger 1 level.

name: Caterpy, the Grappler (level 2)
text: (Power 1: Constant Combat Power) All of your physical attacks do +2 power stages of damage. (Power 2:) When entering Combat, you may discard a Non-Combat card you have in play to raise your anger 2 levels and name a Non-Combat card.
