text: (Constant Combat Power) All your Saiyan Style attacks that do not remove themselves from the game after use are place at the bottom of your Life Deck after use.

name: Broly (lvl 2)
text: When entering Combat, search your Life Deck for a Physical Combat card and place it in your hand. If you then have 6 or more cards in your hand, advance your MP 1 level.

name: King Kai (lvl 1)
text: Energy attack. Costs 1 power stage to perform. If successful, and you declared a Black Tokui-Waza, your opponent must discard a card from his hand.

name: King Kai (lvl 2)
text: Physical attack. Doing +2 power stages of damage. If you declared a Black Tokui-Waza, you may use this power to stop an energy attack instead.

name: King Kai (lvl 3)
text: (Constant Combat Power) The first energy attack you perform during Combat costs 2 less power stages to perform. If you declared a Black Tokui-Waza, all of your energy attacks do +2 life cards of damage.

name: King Cold, the Mighty (lvl 4)
text: (Constant Combat Power) Stop an energy attack. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level.

name: True Grit
text: Energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage. For the remainder of Combat, damage from your attacks cannot be prevented. If successful, remove 6 cards in your opponent's discard pile from the game.

name: Trunks' Speedy Flight
text: Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. Empower 2. Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels. If used by Trunks or Kid Trunks, place a Trunks or Kid Trunks Named card from your discard pile into your hand. Remove from the game after use.

name: Krillin's Overhead Smack
text: Physical attack doing +2 power stages of damage. If performed by a personality without "Puppet" in the title whose power rating is below 300,000, this attack cannot be stopped. Remove from the game after use.

name: Vegeta's Energy Thrust
text: Energy attack. If successful, shuffle all Vegeta Named cards in your discard pile into your Life Deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Trunks' Sword Slice
text: Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. Raise your anger 1 level. If successful, search your Life Deck for any card with "Sword" in the title that is not "Trunks' Sword Slice" and place it into your hand.

name: Frieza's Anger Blast
text: Energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage. If performed by Frieza and you have 2 or more anger, this is a focused attack. This card counts as 1 copy of "Frieza's Irritation Grows" while in your discard pile.

name: Vegeta's Energy Focus
text: Focused Energy Attack doing 5 life cards of damage. If successful, this personality does not have to pay any costs for energy attacks for the remainder of combat.

name: Motherly Rage
text: Chi-Chi only. Discard all of your opponent's Non-Combat cards in play. Remove from the game after use.

name: Piccolo's Power Ball
text: Energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage. If performed by your Main Personality and he currently has a lower power rating than your opponent's Main Personality, this card stays on the table to be used one more time this Combat. Place the bottom card of your discard pile at the bottom of your Life Deck.

name: Gohan's Power Hit
text: Focused physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. Raise your anger 1 level. This attack cannot be stopped by Physical Combat cards. Remove from the game after use.

name: Red Overbearing Attack
text: Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, gain 2 anger. Remove from the game after use.

name: Save!
text: Use when your opponent is about to discard any one of your Allies. Choose one of your Allies that is about to be discarded. The chosen Ally is not discarded.

name: Namekian's Strike
text: Piccolo and Nail only. Energy attack. If you declared Tokui-Waza, you may search your life deck for an energy combat card and place it in your hand.

name: Team Work Kamehameha
text: Energy attack doing 10 life cards and costing 4 power stages to be paid by an ally instead of your main personality.

name: Fatherly Advice
text: Search your deck or discard pile for a physical combat or energy combat card. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Warrior's Preparaton
text: Raise all personalities to their highest power stage.

name: Showing Off Your Power
text: League only. Show your opponent your hand. If all of the cards in your hand are Energy Combat cards, raise your anger 3 levels. This must be the first card you play in Combat. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Multi-form Training
text: League only. For the remainder of the game, any physical attacks from the Saiyan Saga do +3 power stages of damage. Remove from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Garlic Jr's Double Blast
text: Tuff Enuff only. Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. If performed by Garlic Jr., and the damage from this attack defeats your opponent, your opponent is overkilled.

name: Blast From the Past
text: League only. For the remainder of the game, any energy attacks from the Frieza Saga do +3 life cards of damage. Remove from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Energy Explosion
text: League only. Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. If successful, and there is a Battleground in play, discard the Battleground and return this card to your hand instead of discarding it. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Pain Hurts
text: Use after you discard or remove an Ally from play. All of your opponent's Allies lose 4 power stages to a minimum of 0. Your opponent's Main Personality loses 3 power stages. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Gohan's Defense Drill
text: League and Gohan only. Defense Shield. Stops the first unstopped attack performed against Gohan during Combat.

name: I'm a Popo in a Bottle...
text: League only. Attach this card to an Ally in play. Until this card is no longer attached to this Ally, he cannot take control of Combat, and cannot have damage redirected to him. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Line Up
text: Search your Life Deck for either Vegeta, Trunks, Gohan, Piccolo, Krillin, Tien or Yamcha and place that Ally into play at 3 power stages above 0, regardless of the current level of your Main Personality.

name: Krillin's Help
text: League only. Any Allies in play this Combat that were discarded and/or removed from the game are placed into play at 3 power stages above 0. Use at the end of Combat.

name: Below the Belt
text: League and Krillin only. Physical attack doing +3 life cards of damage. You may remove 15 cards with even card numbers in your discard pile from the game. If successful and you removed the 15 card from your discard pile, your opponent must pass in his next 3 "Attacker Attacks" phases this Combat.

name: Krillin's Face Slap
text: Tuff Enuff only. Physical attack doing +2 power stages of damage. The first time you perform this attack, you may remove any amount of Krillin Named cards in your discard pile from the game. For every 4 Krillin Named cards removed, this attack stays on the table to be used 1 more time this Combat.

name: Clash of the Titans
text: League only. Use when entering Combat. All players set their Main Personalities at their highest power stage and draws 5 cards. Your opponent's Main Personality may pay 3 power stages when you use this card to stop its effects.

name: Feeding Frenzy
text: League only. For the remainder of Combat, whenever you play a card from your hand, place the bottom 2 cards of your discard pile on the bottom of your Life Deck to have your Main Personality gain 2 power stages. Remove from the game after use.

name: Taunt
text: If your opponent does not perform an attack during his next "Attacker Attacks" phase, he must play with his hand face up on the table until the beginning of his next turn.

name: I Want You!
text: League only. Use at the beginning of your opponent's Power Up Step. Your opponent cannot skip the Combat Step of this turn. Limit 1 per deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: That Tickles!
text: League only. For the remainder of Combat, whenever one of your successful physical attacks does less than 5 power stages of damage, your opponent discards the top card of his Life Deck and cannot perform an attack during his next "Attacker Attacks" phase.

name: Defensive Stance
text: League and Tuff Enuff only. Use as a defense. Prevent all but 2 life cards of damage dealt to you by the attack just performed against you. Remove from the game after use.

name: Super Arm Cannon of Super Stuff!
text: League and Tuff Enuff only. Energy attack doing 12 life cards of damage. Costs 7 power stages to perform. When you perform this attack, you may discard any of your Non-Combat cards in play to reduce the cost of this attack by 2 power stages for each Non-Combat card you discard for this effect.

name: Huge Strength Maneuver
text: League and Tuff Enuff only. Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage for every 4 power stages this personality is above 0. Raise your anger 1 level. If damage from this attack is redirected to an Ally, the power stages of damage become life cards of damage instead.

name: Yamcha Practice Drill
text: League and Tuff Enuff only. When a physical attack you perform becomes successful, place a card in your discard pile under this Drill face down. When entering Combat, and there are at least 4 cards under this Drill, you may discard the cards under this Drill to have all your physical attacks do +4 power stages of damage for that Combat.

name: Yamcha Vigor
text: Yamcha only. Focused physical attack doing 5 life cards of damage. If successful, your opponent skips his next "Attacker Attacks" phase and the next energy attack you perform this Combat is a focused attack. Remove from the game after use.

name: Out for a Walk
text: League and Tuff Enuff only. Use during your Non-Combat Step. At the end of the turn, you may search your Life Deck for any 2 Allies and place them into play at 4 power stages above 0 if you skipped the Combat Step of this turn.

name: Mean Squeeze
text: League and Tuff Enuff only. Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. Set all players' anger levels to 0. Drills may not be used for the remainder of Combat. Damage from this attack cannot be prevented.

name: Smokin' Barrels
text: League and Tuff Enuff only. Use when one of your energy attacks becomes successful. Raise the attacking personality to his highest power stage. Place the top 2 cards of your discard pile on the bottom of your Life Deck. Draw a card. Remove from the game after use.

name: Head to Head Action
text: League and Tuff Enuff only. Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. For the remainder of Combat, any player may discard a card from his hand to perform a physical attack doing +2 power stages of damage or an energy attack costing 2 power stages to perform.

name: Goku's Jump Kick
text: League, Tuff Enuff, and Goku only. Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. If you have used "Goku's Farewell" this game, lower your anger 2 levels (this overrides the first effect of "Goku's Farewell"). If Chi-Chi is in play, this is a focused attack. Limit 1 per deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Kick Him When He's Down
text: League and Tuff Enuff only. Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. Raise your anger 1 level. If your opponent passed in his last "Attacker Attacks" phase and you had a successful attack in your last Attacker Attacks phase, your opponent loses 4 power stages and this attack does an addition +4 power stages of damage.

name: Wedding
text: Goku only. Attach to your Chi-Chi. While attached, you may draw the bottom card of your discard pile when entering Combat. Chi-Chi may only have 1 "Wedding" attached.

name: Think Really Really Hard
text: League and Tuff Enuff only. Your opponent chooses "even" or "odd". Discard the top card of your Life Deck and look at the card number. If your opponent guessed correct, raise your Main Personality to his highest power stage, place the bottom 5 cards of your discard pile on the bottom of your life deck and shuffle this card into your Life Deck.

name: Hercule's Nibble
text: League and Tuff Enuff only. Your opponent discards the top 2 cards of his Life Deck. Shuffle into your Life Deck after use.

name: Majin Buu's Restoration
text: Tuff Enuff only. You may remove 3 cards in your discard pile from the game to place an Ally of any level from your discard pile into play at 3 power stages above 0. This card stays on the table to be used as many times as you want this Combat. Remove from the game after use.

name: Majin Buu's Assault
text: Endurance 3. Physical attack doing +5 power stages of damage. You may search your Life Deck for a copy of "Hideous Intent" and place it into your hand. If successful, discard one of your opponent's Non-Combat cards in play.

name: Vegeta's Percussion Concussion
text: Tuff Enuff only. Physical attack doing +5 power stages of damage. If successful, remove your opponent's discard pile from the game and raise your anger 2 levels.

name: Power of Cookies!!!
text: Sensei Deck Only. Discard a Non-Combat card or Ally in play. Search your opponent's Life Deck for up to 2 cards and remove them from the game. Your opponent searches your Life Deck for up to 2 cards and removes them from the game. Remove from the game after use.

name: Half-Nelson
text: Physical attack doing +2 power stages of damage. If successful, attach to your opponent's Main Personality. While this card is attached, the owner of Half-Nelson may discard a card from his hand during his "Attacker Attacks" phase to make the attached personality discard the top 2 cards of his Life Deck.

name: Grand Kai's Palace
text: When one of your Celestial Fighters stops an attack with a card that removes itself from the game after use, you may place that card at the bottom of your Life Deck instead of removing it from the game.

name: Orange Conversion Drill
text: During your "Attacker Attacks" phase, you may discard a Non-Combat card from your hand to have your Main Personality perform an energy attack that costs 1 power stage to perform.

name: Black Stomach Breaker
text: Endurance 2. Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. For the remainder of Combat, all your cards with Endurance have their Endurance increased by +2. Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels.

name: Mr.Popo (level 1)
text: Physical attack doing +2 power stages of damage. If successful, your opponent discards a card from his hand.

name: Mr.Popo (level 2)
text: The first styled attack you perform during Combat gains "If successful, your opponent discards a card from his hand." If your opponent did not declare a Tokui-Waza or declared a Freestyle Tokui-Waza, all attacks you perform gains this.

name: Mr.Popo (level 3)
text: This personality gains 3 power stages. This card can affect Dragon Balls. Choose 1 card at random from your opponent's hand and remove it from the game.

name: Rescuing Drill
text: (This card does not affect the Ally rules for overlaying) When you use a card effect to search your Life Deck for an Ally that is placed immediately in play, that Ally may have a higher personality level than your Main Personality.

name: Feverish
text: Attach to one of your opponent's personalities. While attached, this personality's PUR is -1, to a minimum of 0.

name: Frieza's Daunting Bombardment
text: Focused energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage. If used by Frieza, for the remainder of Combat all your attacks from Frieza Named cards do an additional +3 life cards of damage. If successful, shuffle all Frieza Named cards in your discard pile into your Life Deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Interview with the Green Guy
text: For the remainder of Combat, your attacks do +2 power stages of damage for each Namekian Heritage personality and each Saibaimen personality in play. If your Main Personality is Saibaimen, then for the remainder of Combat, all of your energy attacks from Saiyan Saga, Frieza Saga, and Trunks Saga are focused attacks. Remove from the game after use.

name: DELETED!
text: Physical attack doing +6 power stages of damage. Costs 6 power stages to perform. If successful, discard up to 6 Non-Combat cards in play. Remove from the game after use.

name: Gotenks' Potential
text: If your Main Personality is a fused personality, shuffle 7 cards in your discard pile into your Life Deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Nagging Drill
text: All your attacks do +2 power stages of damage.

name: Goku's High Kick
text: Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. Lower your opponent's anger 3 levels. If successful, all Goku Named cards in your Life Deck without Endurance gain Endurance 2 for the remainder of Combat.

name: Goku, the Mighty (level 1)
text: Whenever you stop an attack with a card from the Frieza Saga, you may shuffle it back into your Life Deck after use.

name: Tien, the Swift (lvl 1)
text: Physical attack. Your opponent skips his next Attacker attacks phase. During your next attacker attacks phase, perform another physical attack.

name: Krillin, the Hero (lvl 2)
text: Energy attack. You may use this power twice per combat.

name: Android 16 (R3-lvl 1)
text: (Constant Combat Power) During your turn, if you skip the combat step, during your rejuvenation step lower your opponents anger by 2 levels.

name: Android 16, the Machine (lvl 2)
text: (Constant Combat Power) Whenever your opponent stops one of your physical attacks, lower his main personality 2 power stages.

name: Android 17 (R5-lvl 1)
text: Search your life deck or discard pile for "The Car" and place it into play.

name: Android 17, the Leader (lvl 2)
text: Energy attack doing +3 life cards of damage if "The Car" is in play.

name: Android 18 (R7-lvl 1)
text: Choose and Ally in play. Your opponent cannot redirect damage to that Ally and the Ally cannot take over Combat. If you have "The Car" in play, you can choose up to 2 Allies instead of 1.

name: Android 18, the Model (lvl 2)
text: Physical attack doing +5 power stages of damage. If "The Car" is in play, you may use this power twice per Combat.

name: Cell, Stage One (lvl 1)
text: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, you may use this power twice per Combat.

name: Cell (lvl 2)
text: (Constant Combat Power) Whenever your opponent uses a power or effect that lets him draw one or more cards, draw one card.

name: Super Saiyan Vegeta (lvl 1)
text: Search your discard pile for a Vegeta named card and shuffle it back into your Life Deck.

name: King Kai's New Home
text: Whenever any player has 4 or more cards in his hand, or 5 or more if he declared a Saiyan Tokui-Waza, he may not draw any more cards into his hand.

name: Goku's House
text: Once per Combat, a player may shuffle the top 2 Combat cards in his discard pile back into his Life Deck.

name: Android 16, the Warrior (lvl 4)
text: Reveal the top card of your Life Deck. If it can perform a physical attack, you may immediately perform it directly from your Life Deck. The physical attack does +3 power stages of damage. Otherwise, discard the card.

name: Android 17, the Energized (lvl 4)
text: Physical attack doing 6 life cards of damage. If "The Car" is in play, this attack does +3 power stages of damage.

name: Android 18, the Survivor (lvl 4)
text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. Costs 1 power stage to perform. If "The Car" is in play, you may perform this attack twice per Combat.

name: Android 19, Refreshed (lvl 4)
text: (Constant Combat Power) For each life card of damage Android 19 deals with a successful energy attack, Android 19 gains 1 power stage.

name: Android 20, the Mastermind (lvl 4)
text: Your opponent discards the top X cards of his Life Deck. X = the number of personalities in play with "Android" in the title.

name: Remote Control
text: If your opponent's Main Personality has "Android" in the title, remove the top 2 cards of your opponent's Life Deck from the game and then discard the next top 3 cards of his Life Deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Cell's Choke Hold
text: Physical attack doing +1 life cards of damage. If successful, your opponent discards 2 cards from his Life Deck for each card in his hand.

name: Peekaboo!
text: Endurance X. X = The number of Dragon Balls you control. Reveal any number of cards in your hand to your opponent. Your opponent reveals the same number of cards in his hand.

name: Big Man on Campus
text: If your Main Personality's power rating is higher than your opponent's Main Personality, you may discard up to 2 of your opponent's Allies and up to 2 of your opponent's Non-Combat cards in play. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Gohan's Heroic Uppercut
text: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. If performed against a villain, this attack stays on the table to be used 1 more time this Combat. Raise your anger 1 level. Remove from the game after use.

name: Black Smackdown
text: (Tuff Enuff Only) Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, and your opponent has a Battleground or Location in play, this attack cannot be stopped.

name: Blue Smackdown
text: (Tuff Enuff Only) Physical attack doing +5 power stages of damage. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, and you have more than 3 anger, this attack cannot be stopped.

name: Namekian Smackdown
text: (Tuff Enuff Only) Physical attack doing 6 power stages of damage. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, and your opponent is at 5 stages above 0 or higher, this attack cannot be stopped.

name: Orange Smackdown
text: (Tuff Enuff Only) Physical attack doing 6 life cards of damage. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, and your opponent has a Drill in play, this attack cannot be stopped.

name: Red Smackdown
text: (Tuff Enuff Only) Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, and you have no Non-Combat cards in play, this attack cannot be stopped.

name: Saiyan Smackdown
text: (Tuff Enuff Only) Physical attack doing 6 power stages of damage. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, and if your Main Personality is at 0, this attack cannot be stopped.

name: Garlic Jr.'s Palm Blast
text: (Tuff Enuff Only) Energy attack doing +1 life card for every card in your hand. If you declared a Saiyan Tokui-Waza, this must be the first attack that you play during Combat. Discard a card.

name: Loser With Style Drill
text: (Tuff Enuff Only) Once per Combat, in place of an attack, you may draw 2 cards after you have taken 10 or more life cards of damage during this Combat. You can only have 1 copy of this Drill in play at a time.

name: Krillin's Coolness Drill
text: (Tuff Enuff Only) If you declared a non-Saiyan, non-Black Tokui-Waza all of your attacks do +2 power stages of damage.

name: Are You Tuff Enuff???
text: (Tuff Enuff Only) Endurance 100. All players gain 100 anger.

name: Bubbles Drill
text: (Tuff Enuff Only) When entering Combat name a card. That card cannot be played for the remainder of Combat. Discard 1 life card when you name the card. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Namekian Side Swipe
text: (Tuff Enuff Only) Physical attack doing +5 power stages of damage. If you declared a Tokui-Waza shuffle the top or bottom card of your discard pile into your Life Deck.

name: Orange Energy Stance
text: (Tuff Enuff Only) Stops an energy attack. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, gain 4 power stages. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level.

name: Namekian Charging Stance
text: (Tuff Enuff Only) Stops a physical attack. If you declared a Tokui-Waza power up to full. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level.

name: Blue Show Off
text: (Tuff Enuff Only) Villains only. Physical attack doing +2 power stages of damage. If Goku is in play, it stays on the table to be used 2 more times this Combat. Remove from the game after use.

name: Straining Double Strike Move
text: (Tuff Enuff Only) Physical attack doing 5 power stages of damage. Your opponent gains 1 anger. This card stays on the table to be used 1 more time this Combat. Remove from the game after use.

name: Saiyan Anger Strike
text: (Tuff Enuff Only) Physical attack doing +2 power stages of damage for every anger level you are above 0.

name: Black Energy Stance
text: (Tuff Enuff Only) Stops a physical or energy attack. If your opponent has 3 or more anger he must discard a card from his hand.

name: Blue Goku's Power Kick
text: (Tuff Enuff Only) Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. If used by Goku, and you declared a Tokui-Waza, this card stays on the table to be used 1 more time this Combat. Remove from the game after use.

name: Blue Frustration Drill
text: (Tuff Enuff Only) Whenever your opponent stops 1 of your attacks you lose 2 power stages. All of your attacks deal +2 power stages of damage.

name: Black Transformation
text: (Tuff Enuff Only) Stops a physical or energy attack. If you declared a Tokui-Waza gain 1 anger. Remove from game after use.

name: Tien and Yamcha Strike
text: (Tuff Enuff Only) Physical attack doing +2 power stages of damage. If used by Tien or Yamcha do +4 power stages instead. This card stays on the table to be used 1 more time this Combat.

name: Gohan's Kamehameha
text: Focused energy attack doing +1 life cards of damage for each card in your discard pile with "Kamehameha" in the title. Raise your anger 1 level.

name: It's Empty?
text: Search your Life Deck for a level 1 Ally and place it into play facedown. You may ignore the Ally uniqueness rule for this Ally. When you redirect damage from an attack to this Ally, or when you have this Ally take control of Combat, you turn this Ally faceup and set him at his highest power stage.

name: Supreme Kai Sensei
text: (Deck Size: 11) Once per game during your Non-Combat Step, shuffle up to 5 styled cards in your discard pile into your Life Deck.

name: Majin Rapid Fire
text: Majin only. Use when you perform an energy attack and you have performed an energy attack during your previous "Attacker Attacks" phase, the energy attack is shuffled into your Life Deck after use, even if it would normally remove itself from the game.

name: Stop!
text: End Combat. All players discard all cards in their hands. Remove from the game after use.

name: Majin Buu's Childish Taunt
text: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. For the remainder of the game, your opponent cannot use any cards that let him look at cards in your hand or your Life Deck. If used by Majin Buu, this attack is focused and raises your anger 1 level.

name: Multi-Purpose Strike
text: Physical attack doing +5 power stages of damage or stops a focused energy attack. When you use this card, it is the style of your choice. While it is in your discard pile, it is the style of your choice. This card cannot be more than 1 style at once.

name: Racing Drill
text: When entering Combat, both players discard the top card of their Life Deck. If both cards discarded this way are not the same card type, your opponent discards the next top card of his Life Deck.

name: Overhead Squeal
text: Physical attack doing 7 power stages of damage. If this attack deals damage to an Ally, that Ally is discarded. If your Main Personality is at 5 power stages above 0 or higher, shuffle this card back into your Life Deck after use.

name: Gohan, Released (lvl 3)
text: Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage or energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage.

name: Majin Buu's Loogie
text: Sensei deck. If your opponent has a Physical Combat, Energy Combat, or Combat card in play that can be used an addition time(s) this Combat, discard the top 10 cards of your opponent's Life Deck.

name: A New Addition
text: (You may place an Ally into play with this effect even if your opponent has the same level of that personality in play as an Ally) Search your Life Deck for an Ally and place it into play at 5 power stages above 0.

name: Pan's Victory
text: Shuffle up to 4 cards in your discard pile into your Life Deck. Remove up to 4 cards in your opponent's discard pile from the game. Remove from the game after use.

name: Jawbreaker Hail Storm
text: You may immediately place a Non-Combat card from your hand into play.

name: Homework Time...
text: Name a non-Dragon Ball card. Look through the top 5 cards of your Life Deck for it. If it is there, show it to your opponent and set the 5 cards aside in the order they were in to shuffle any 5 cards in your discard pile into your Life Deck. Now place the 5 cards on top of your Life Deck.

name: Impressive Power
text: Your Main Personality gains 5 power stages. For the remainder of Combat, whenever your Main Personality performs a styled physical attack, you may pay 3 power stages to make it a focused attack.

name: Piccolo's Multiform
text: Piccolo only. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, then any physical attacks Piccolo performs that cannot stay on the table to be used again this Combat may stay on the table to be used once more this Combat. Remove from the game after use.

name: Majin Funny Face
text: If you declared a Tokui-Waza, any "If Successful" effects on Physical Combat and Energy Combat cards are "If stopped" instead. If your anger has already been raised 2 or more levels this Combat, draw a card.

name: Unbelievable Strength
text: For the remainder of Combat, whenever your opponent stops one of your attacks, he discards the top 2 cards of his Life Deck.

name: Ki-Charged Palm Block
text: Stops a physical attack. For the remainder of Combat, any cards in your Life Deck that do not have Endurance have Endurance 2. Remove from the game after use.

name: Super Saiyan Gohan (lvl 1)
text: When entering Combat as the attacker, you may draw a card.

name: Videl's Head Kick
text: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. If your opponent's Main Personality has a higher power rating than your Main Personality, then this attack deals +6 power stages of damage instead.

name: Saiyan Training (IR)
text: Your PUR is +1 until the end of the game. Remove from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Blue Saving Catch Drill
text: Your Allies in play cannot be discarded. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Excitement
text: Use during the Non-Combat Step. Show your opponent your hand. Draw a card for each Non-Combat card in your hand.

name: Strike a Pose
text: The next attack you perform this Combat costs 2 less power stages to perform. If the attack is stopped, your opponent discards 3 life cards.

name: Babidi's Evil Plans
text: Villains only. Reshuffle this card into your Life Deck. If this card gets discarded from an attack after it's been reshuffled, your opponent discards 5 life cards. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Red Blowing Steam Drill
text: All of your attacks do +X power stages of damage. X = your anger level. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Stop Fighting
text: Stops a physical attack. End Combat. Bulma and Chi-Chi must be in play to play this card. Unless your Main Personality is Bulma, limit 1 per deck.

name: Pose with Style
text: Whenever you use a Non-Combat card that is not a Drill, you may discard this card instead of that Non-Combat card. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Releasing the Sword
text: Use when entering Combat. Reveal the top 7 cards of your Life Deck. Place in play any Non-Combat cards revealed and shuffle the rest back into your Life Deck.

name: Long Journey
text: Use this card during the Non-Combat Step. Search your Life Deck for up to 3 Drills and place them into your hand. You must skip the Combat Step for your next 2 turns. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Black Upward Dodge
text: Stops a physical attack. Your next attack deals +4 life cards of damage in this Combat.

name: Saiyan Face Jab
text: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. If successful, your opponent pays +2 power stages for his next attack in this Combat.

name: Gotenk's Head Butt
text: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. If successful, prevent 3 power stages of damage from attacks performed against you for the remainder of Combat.

name: Tien's Power Stance
text: Tien only. Power Tien to his highest power stage. The next energy attack Tien performs this Combat gets to be performed 1 more time including any secondary effects. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Pikkon's Leg Catch
text: Stops a physical attack. Power your Main Personality to his highest power stage. Shuffle the bottom 3 cards of your discard pile back into your Life Deck.

name: Gohan's Nimbus Cloud
text: Search your Life Deck for a Location and place it into play. Draw a card. Unless your Main Personality is Gohan, limit 1 per deck.

name: Emotional Baggage
text: Vegeta only. Use this card immediately when Trunks is in play as an Ally and then is discarded or removed from the game. Gain 2 anger.

name: Champion Drill
text: Once per Combat, in place of an attack, discard a card from your hand and draw the top two cards from your Life Deck. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Victorious Drill
text: Before the first turn begins, you may search your Life Deck for this Drill and place it into play. When entering Combat, lower your opponent's anger 2 levels and your Main Personality gains 2 power stages. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Champion's Aura
text: Endurance 1,000,000. Your opponent looks at the top 5 cards of your Life Deck and chooses 2 of them. Place those 2 cards in your hand and discard the other 3.

name: Let the Games Begin!
text: Use when entering Combat and your Main Personality is at level 1. You cannot win by the Most Powerful Personality Victory for the remainder of the game. Advance your Main Personality to level 2. Shuffle the bottom 5 cards of your discard pile into your Life Deck.

name: Majin Throwdown
text: All Majin only attacks do an additional +1 power stages and +1 life cards of damage. All Majin only attacks discard an Ally in play when they are performed. When entering Combat, all players must discard one of their Non-Combat cards in play.

name: Majin Mastery
text: You cannot win by the Most Powerful Personality Victory. You can use Tuff Enuff only cards.

name: Broku (Level 1)
text: (This personality may use Saiyan Heritage cards) When entering Combat, draw 2 cards. All of your Saiyan Style attacks do an additional +2 life cards of damage.

name: Vegecell (Level 1)
text: (This personality may use Saiyan Heritage cards) Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. You may use this attack 2 additional times this Combat.

name: Buuhan (Level 1)
text: (This personality may use Saiyan Heritage cards) Remove a Non-Combat card in play from the game. Capture one of your opponent's Dragon Balls.

name: Dailende (Level 1)
text: (This personality may use Namekian Heritage cards) Energy attack doing 8 life cards of damage. Costs 0 power stages to perform. If stopped, your opponent discards the top 4 cards of his Life Deck. You may use this attack an additional time this Combat.

name: Piccillin (Level 1)
text: (You cannot play Krillin's Heat Seeking Blast. This personality may use Namekian Heritage cards) The first Non-Focused attack you perform each Combat does an additional +1 power stages of damage for each Styled card in your discard pile.

name: Yamcule (Level 1)
text: (You may play both "Heroes only." and "Villains only." cards) Shuffle the top 7 cards of your discard pile into your Life Deck.
